title: Fantasy Land Crystal
description: Fantasy Crashes in! The party starts, and you are the creator! Make your life easier, and better! :)
body:
Fantasy Land is one of my BEST projects to this day!



Fantasy style Minecraft is just one of the most amazing things I have seen, and I feel amazed when seeing this kind of stuff in Minecraft. And if I like it to be a mod, and make it, you should be able to use it... right?! :)



Fantasy Land aims to add the most fantasy blocks, items, and maybe even mobs in the far future. But anyways, land is amazing, and fantasy makes Minecraft better, so that is how I chose this title, "Fantasy Land".



I hope you enjoy this mod, and are excited to use it, if you give this a try, I promise you, (if you like fantasy theme) you will have a fun and FANTASTIC time! Happy Modding! :)



This Fantasy mod also will add furniture in the future, so hope to see those updates, and have fun with the mod.

This mod could effect the player's experience in Minecraft in some possible positive ways: Fun, New Blocks, New Items, New Crafting Recipies, New Biomes, Etc.

This mod could however... effect the player's experiencein Minecraft in some possible negative ways: Possibly Not Vanilla Friendly, Too Much For The User, To Complicated (maybe), and even: Needing REI or JEI for figuring out the crafting recipes.



But other than that, this mod straight aims to make the user's experience better and fun, with positive effects, not any negative effects. (This mod - and my other mods - allow comments here, (Not Modrinth), so come to Curseforge to comment on my mods, and if there are anything's or people bothering you (related to my mod), then comment your problems. And even comment positive effects! :) )

Check out the images!
